error.notPlant: Setshwantsho se ga se bontshe semela, ka jalo ga se a sekasekwa. Tsaya setshwantsho sa gaufi, se se bonalang sentle, sa matlhare, kutu kgotsa maungo a semela mme o leke gape.
error.tooMany: Dikopo di dintsi thata. Tsweetswee ema sebakanyana mme o leke gape.
error.network: Ga e kgone go fitlhelela sefatlhosi sa Crop Advisor. Tlhatlhoba kgolagano ya gago ya inthanete mme o leke gape.
error.photoType: Tsweetswee tlhopha setshwantsho (JPEG, PNG kgotsa WebP).
home.scanText: Tsaya setshwantsho kgotsa o se latlhele fa. AI e tlhatlhoba boitekanelo jwa sone, mathata, kgato ya kgolo, ditlhokego tsa monontsha le go siamela go roba.
home.selectedPhoto: Setshwantsho sa semela se se tlhophilweng
home.notesPlaceholder: sk. Matlhare a mosetlha a a nang le didikologo tse ditshotlha mo dikaleng tsa kwa tlase morago ga beke ya pula
home.chooseFirst: Tlhopha setshwantsho fa godimo go simolola.
home.recentEmpty: Ditshekatsheko tsa dimela tsa gago di tla bonala fa.
home.photoTip: Kgakololo ya setshwantsho: tsaya setshwantsho motshegare, tlatsa foreime ka matlhare kgotsa maungo a a amegileng, mme o oketse tlhaloso e khutshwane ya se o se bonang.
home.busyTitle: Semela sa gago se a sekasekwa
home.step1: Go tlhatlhobiwa gore setshwantsho se bontsha semela…
home.step2: Go batliwa matshwao a malwetse le ditshenekegi…
home.step3: Go fopholediwa kgolo le go siamela go roba…
home.step4: Go kwalwa dikgakololo tsa kalafi le monontsha…
analysis.deleteConfirm: Phimola tshekatsheko eno le setshwantsho sa yone?
analysis.expertTitle: Netefatsa le motlhatlheledi pele o fafatsa kgotsa o reka sepe
analysis.expertNote: Bontsha pego eno go motlhankedi wa temo wa selegae kgotsa mmoki wa temo. Dirisa konopo ya go gatisa go e boloka jaaka PDF.
expert.severe: Go bonwe bothata jo bogolo jo bo ka anamang kgotsa jwa baka ditatlhegelo tse dikgolo.
expert.unsure_problem: AI ga e na bonnete gore bothata ke eng.
expert.unsure_crop: AI ga e na bonnete gore ke sejalo sefe, ka jalo dikgakololo di ka nna tsa se tshwanele.
expert.offline: Se ke tekanyetso e e theilweng fela mo mmaleng wa letlhare; sekao sa AI se ne se sa bonale.
analysis.noIssues: Ga go na malwetse, ditshenekegi kgotsa tlhaelo tse di bonweng. Tswelela ka tiro e ntle!
analysis.treatmentIntro: Go ya ka bothata jo bo bonweng, kaelo e e tla go thusa go alafa sejalo sa gago:
analysis.noTreatment: Semela sa gago se lebega se itekanetse — ga go tlhokege kalafi. Latela dikgakololo tsa thibelo gore se nne jalo.
analysis.safety: Dirisa fela ditlhagiswa tsa tshireletso ya dijalo tse di kwadisitsweng sejalo sa gago mo nageng ya gago. Latela leibole, apara diaparo tsa tshireletso mme o tlotle nako ya go ema pele ga thobo. Netefatsa maemo a a masisi le motlhankedi wa temo wa selegae.
analysis.fullPlan: Bula leano le le feletseng la paka →
analysis.expectedGrade: Seemo sa boleng se se solofetsweng
analysis.offlineEngine: Motheo wa kitso o o sa golaganang
analysis.disclaimer: Ditshitshinyo tsa AI di a tshegetsa, mme ga di tseye sebaka sa dikgakololo tsa motlhankedi wa temo wa selegae.
chat.welcome: Dumela! Ke nna mothusi wa gago wa Crop Advisor AI. Nka thusa go tlhaola malwetse a dimela, tsamaiso ya dikotla, dikgakololo tsa go nosetsa le dikgakololo tsa go tlhokomela dijalo. Nka go thusa jang gompieno?
chat.title: Mothusi wa Crop Advisor AI
chat.ex1: Ke ka ntlha yang fa matlhare a ditamati tsa me a fetoga mosetlha?
chat.ex2: Ke tshwanetse go nosetsa dimela tse ga kae?
chat.ex3: Nka dira eng ka dintlha tse mo matlhareng a me?
chat.ex4: A ditamati tsa me di siametse go robiwa?
chat.ex5: Nka tokafatsa jang tlhagiso ya dijalo tsa me?
chat.ex6: Ke alafa jang blight ya tamati?
chat.photoQuestion: Tsweetswee leba setshwantsho se sa semela sa me. O bona eng mme ke tshwanetse go dira eng?
chat.scanContext: Mothusi o dirisa tlhatlhobo ya sekeno se fa a araba.
chat.stopDiscussing: Emisa go buisana ka sekeno se
chat.photoAttached: Setshwantsho se tsentswe — botsa potso kgotsa o romele fela.

auth.haveAccount: O setse o na le akhaonto?

auth.mismatch: Mafoko a sephiri ga a tshwane.
auth.wrong: Nomore ya mogala, imeile kgotsa lefoko la sephiri ga di a siama.
auth.exists: Akhaonto e e nang le nomore eno ya mogala kgotsa imeile e setse e le teng. Tsena go na le moo.

camera.denied: Khamera e thibetswe. Tobetsa letshwao la khamera mo bareng ya aterese, o tlhophe Letla, mme o leke gape. (Sebatli sa ka fa gare sa VS Code ga se kgone go dirisa khamera: bula saete mo Chrome kgotsa Edge.)
camera.none: Ga go khamera e e bonweng mo sedirisiweng se.
camera.busy: Khamera e dirisiwa ke tiriso e nngwe. E tswale mme o leke gape.
camera.failed: Khamera ga e a kgona go simolola.
camera.useFile: Tlhopha setshwantsho go na le moo
camera.insecure: Khamera e dira fela fa saete e bulwa kwa http://localhost:8080 kgotsa ka https. E bule jalo, kgotsa o tlhophe setshwantsho go na le moo.
